notes: Decorative shape or container background. Built-in geometric shapes via CSS/SVG. API shapes from D1. Can wrap child atoms (Icon, text). textonly: null for decorative. Container behaviour auto-detected from slot/media. Shapes can be ui-control / content-symbol for interactive scrollytelling — they get tabindex, role=img, aria-label, focus indicators just like Icon.

_rules.action: Icon gets auto-contrast colour (oklch inversion) so it's visible against the filled shape background

_rules.note: ui-control and content-symbol shapes must have label for screen readers
drawColor only accepts base colour variants or rainbow — no tier modifiers (tint/mid/emphasis). Atom strips them at runtime via normalizeDrawColour.
When draw and fillAnimation are both used, fillTiming controls whether fill bloom overlaps draw at 50% (default) or starts after draw completes ('after')

mode._note: shape: renders as visible shape. mask: uses shape as clip-path on content.

renderAs._note: auto: CSS for circle/square/rounded/pill, SVG for everything else. css: force CSS path (only valid for css-capable shapes). svg: force SVG path.

slug._note: API shape slug — fetches SVG from Asset Library

semanticRole._note: decorative: aria-hidden. ui-control: tabindex 0 + role=img + label. content-symbol: role=img + label. Container behaviour is auto-detected from slot/media — no separate value needed.

media._description: Component node: { component: 'Icon'|'Image'|'LottieIcon', ...atomProps }. Validated by the child atom's own schema. Presence of media auto-marks the shape as a container.

gradientFocus._note: Radial origin point — only used when gradientType=radial.

gradientEmerge._description: Fade-in modifier — first 50% transparent, fades to solid. Combines with any gradient or solid colour.

gradientFade._description: Fade-out modifier — last 20% fades to transparent. Combines with any gradient or solid colour.

gradientAnimateSpeed._note: Duration in seconds. Default 8s, scales 2x for gentle motion mode.

gradientAnimateEase._note: GSAP ease string (e.g. 'sine.inOut', 'power2.out'). Default 'none' for cw/ccw, 'sine.inOut' for sway.

drawFill._note: Keep origPaths filled underneath while overlay draws border on top

drawGhost._note: Use --svg-ghost-color token for ghost stroke (no separate ghostColor prop needed)

drawColor._note: BASE colours only — no tier modifiers. Tier suffixes are stripped at runtime. Rainbow colours use positional names (rainbow-1..7) matching CSS tokens.

drawWormSize._note: Laser worm segment size as percentage of path length (1-99)

drawOnScroll._note: Trigger draw when element enters viewport

drawScrub._note: Scrub draw progress with scroll position (only with drawOnScroll)

morphTo._note: Built-in shape name OR D1 slug. Goo morph technique applies automatically.

fillAnimation._note: Bloom fill from centre on trigger

fillOutline._note: Also draw stroke outline using addVariant — combines with fillDrawVariant/fillDrawLaser

fillDuration._note: Bloom duration in seconds. Auto-scaled by element size.

fillEase._note: Named ease (jelly|wobble|bounce|snap) or raw GSAP ease string

fillColor._note: CSS variable name (--token) or hex/rgb. If absent, uses element colour.

fillTiming._note: When draw + fill combined: overlap starts fill at 50% draw, after waits for draw to finish
